mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during episodes where GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase of at least 0.4 percentage points over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises by >=0.4pp for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of two consecutive months with UNRATE rising by at least 0.4pp.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both UNRATE and PAYEMS (above their respective 3-month averages) indicates a broad-based labor market expansion, which boosts consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when both UNRATE and PAYEMS exceed their 3-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% signals contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings and increases recession risk, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent fall in both GDPC1 and HOUST below their 6-month moving averages signals a broad-based decline in economic activity, which depresses equity valuations and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST are below their 6-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1% for more than six months in a low-inflation environment signals accommodative monetary policy, which supports risk asset valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: prolonged monetary accommodation with low inflation
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of FEDFUNDS < 1% for over six months and CPIAUCSL < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during three consecutive months of declining RSAFS.
